page.overview:
What is Espeon?

Espeon is a quadrupedal mammalian feline Pokémon. Sleek, lilac-purple fur covers its body, and it has a red jewel embedded into its forehead. Like all Eeveelutions, it has a round head and small features all around. Its face is distinctly cat-like, with a short, blunt muzzle and a tiny, triangular nose. Its paws, legs, and feet are particularly rounded. It has long, pointed triangular-shaped ears, and whisker-like tufts of fur protruding from each side of its face, just below its ears. Its eyes are deep purple and almond-shaped with white pupils. It has a slender tail that tapers and splits into two ends. Compared to its counterparts, Espeon has a closer physical resemblance to cats. It is usually the result of Eevee having a strong friendship with its Trainer during the daytime.

As a Shiny, Espeon has bright green fur while the insides of its ears turn blue. Its eyes and gem remain unchanged.

Espeon are extremely loyal to any Trainers it considers to be worthy. Its precognitive powers enable the Pokémon to protect it and its Trainer from danger. In most cases, it is a friendly but quiet Pokémon.

Espeon are connected with the sun and daylight due to their conditions for evolution. It is said that it gathers psychic energy in its gem through sunbathing, making them poor battlers in the dark of night.
